comment: Per-model capability manifest for the replicate multiplexer. Every entry is documented-best-effort until a maintainer captures a real-API smoke trace for that model — verified:false entries MUST NOT be trusted for planning-critical decisions without surfacing the flag. Durations in seconds; cost_per_second_usd is a modeled estimate, never a quote.

google/veo-3.label: Google Veo 3 (text-to-video, native audio)
google/veo-3.input_notes: fixed 8s clips; dialogue/ambient rendered from the prompt text; resolution flag

kwaivgi/kling-v2.1-master.label: Kling v2.1 Master (text/image-to-video)
kwaivgi/kling-v2.1-master.input_notes: duration enum 5|10; start_image for image-to-video; negative_prompt supported

wan-video/wan-2.2-t2v-fast.label: Wan 2.2 (text-to-video, fast)
wan-video/wan-2.2-t2v-fast.input_notes: num_frames-driven duration; resolution enum; seed supported

lightricks/ltx-video.label: LTX Video (text-to-video)
lightricks/ltx-video.input_notes: length in frames at fixed fps; cfg + negative_prompt supported

tencent/hunyuan-video.label: Hunyuan Video (text-to-video)
tencent/hunyuan-video.input_notes: video_length in frames; embedded_guidance_scale; no negative_prompt
